content.text: No audit, inspection, or usage-verification right against Sparkling exists anywhere in the agreement. The only examination right runs in our favour (escrow materials, p0114), and the only Sparkling reporting duty is a one-time post-termination destruction certificate (p0118), not a recurring audit.

input.quote: (e) not use the Work except as authorized herein;
input.rationale: The use restrictions in § 3 (p0031–p0039), the licence grant in § 2, § 14 (confidentiality), § 17 and the general provisions in § 20 contain no audit, inspection, monitoring or usage-verification right exercisable by Garman against Sparkling, and searches for "audit", "inspect", "verify", "examine", "records", "access", "premises" and "remote" return no such right. The only examination right (p0114, escrow materials) runs in our favour, and p0118 imposes only a one-time post-termination certification of destruction, not a recurring audit or any access to Sparkling systems. Since the rule constrains audit rights binding the Customer, their complete absence is at or better than the preferred position, and no redline is warranted (raising the issue would risk inviting an audit right).
